typeProperties.script:
parameters{
	sFileName as string ('Blackrock_fcmallocfile_01082020_120834037.csv'),
	OLEDBDestination1_outputfilename as string ()
}

source(output(
		{Tran Type} as string,
		Quantity as string,
		{BLK Ticker} as string,
		{Product Code} as string,
		{Security Type} as string,
		{Maturity Month} as string,
		{Maturity Year} as string,
		{Security Description} as string,
		{Price Premium} as string,
		{Put or Call} as string,
		{Strike Price} as string,
		{Executing Broker} as string,
		{Trade Date} as string,
		{Settle Date} as string,
		Portfolio as string,
		{FCM Account} as string,
		Invnum as string,
		{Touch Count} as string,
		FCM as string,
		{Commission Type} as string,
		{Trade Type} as string,
		{OCC Symbol} as string,
		{Maturity Date} as string,
		{Exercise Type} as string,
		Exchange as string,
		Currency as string,
		{Net Money} as string,
		{Alloc Type} as string,
		{Trade ID} as string,
		{Executing Commission} as string,
		{Clearing Commission} as string,
		{Exchange Fee} as string,
		{Other Fee} as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false) ~> FCMAllocations
FCMAllocations split(isNull(Tran Type) || Tran Type == '', disjoint: true) ~> ConditionalSplit@(BlankTranType,HasTranType)
ConditionalSplit@HasTranType derive(LoadDate = currentTimestamp(),
		FileName = $sFileName,
		FileDate = substring(toString($sFileName), toInteger(24), toInteger(8))) ~> DeriveFileName
DeriveFileName derive({Copy of FileName} = FileName,
		{Copy of FileDate} = FileDate) ~> DataConversion
DataConversion sink(input(
		LoadDate as timestamp 'dd-MM-yyyy',
		TranType as string,
		ExecutingCommission as string,
		SecurityType as string,
		Invnum as string,
		ClearingCommission as string,
		TradeID as string,
		FileName as string,
		TradeType as string,
		ExchangeFee as string,
		FileDate as string,
		ExecutingBroker as string,
		MaturityYear as string,
		BLKTicker as string,
		Currency as string,
		NetMoney as string,
		TradeDate as string,
		FCMAccount as string,
		SettleDate as string,
		StrikePrice as string,
		TouchCount as string,
		ProductCode as string,
		Portfolio as string,
		Quantity as string,
		AllocType as string,
		MaturityDate as string,
		OCCSymbol as string,
		ExerciseType as string,
		Exchange as string,
		FCM as string,
		MaturityMonth as string,
		SecurityDescription as string,
		OtherFee as string,
		PutorCall as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	saveOrder: 10000,
	mapColumn(
		LoadDate,
		TranType = {Tran Type},
		ExecutingCommission = {Executing Commission},
		SecurityType = {Security Type},
		Invnum,
		ClearingCommission = {Clearing Commission},
		TradeID = {Trade ID},
		FileName = {Copy of FileName},
		TradeType = {Trade Type},
		ExchangeFee = {Exchange Fee},
		FileDate = {Copy of FileDate},
		ExecutingBroker = {Executing Broker},
		MaturityYear = {Maturity Year},
		BLKTicker = {BLK Ticker},
		Currency,
		NetMoney = {Net Money},
		TradeDate = {Trade Date},
		FCMAccount = {FCM Account},
		SettleDate = {Settle Date},
		StrikePrice = {Strike Price},
		TouchCount = {Touch Count},
		ProductCode = {Product Code},
		Portfolio,
		Quantity,
		AllocType = {Alloc Type},
		MaturityDate = {Maturity Date},
		OCCSymbol = {OCC Symbol},
		ExerciseType = {Exercise Type},
		Exchange,
		FCM,
		MaturityMonth = {Maturity Month},
		SecurityDescription = {Security Description},
		OtherFee = {Other Fee},
		PutorCall = {Put or Call}),
	partitionFileNames:[($OLEDBDestination1_outputfilename)],
	partitionBy('hash', 1)) ~> OLEDBDestination1
